say:0:1120602001:0.text: Looks like someone's in trouble up ahead, Magister.
say:0:1120602001:0.source_cn: 主人，前面有人遇到麻烦了！
say:0:1120602001:0.male: Looks like someone's in trouble up ahead, Magister.
say:0:1120602001:0.female: Looks like someone's in trouble up ahead, Magister.

say:1:1120602002:0.text: Assaulting people in broad daylight, eh? We have to stop them!
say:1:1120602002:0.source_cn: 竟然在光天化日之下当街抢劫，我们得阻止他们！

say:1:1120603001:0.text: Tell me, where is Lester's treasure hidden?!
say:1:1120603001:0.source_cn: 说，英灵卡斯特的宝藏在哪？

say:3:1120603002:0.text: You're not leaving anytime soon, so start talking!

say:6:1120603003:1.text: Please just listen to me! There is no treasure... I swear! I... I just made it all up...
say:6:1120603003:1.source_cn: 不，你们听、听我说……真的没有什么宝藏……我发誓！那…...

say:7:1120603004:1.text: "Made it all up", you say? Looks like you're still holding out on us.
say:7:1120603004:1.source_cn: 编的故事？嘿，你倒是挺嘴硬的。

say:8:1120603005:1.text: This is your brother, right? Tell me what I want to know right now... Or I'll tie him up and ditch him in the desert.
say:8:1120603005:1.source_cn: 这是你兄弟吧？你要是不说实话……我就把他捆起来丢进荒漠里。

say:9:1120603006:1.text: Between the heat, the scorpions, and the lack of food and water... I wonder how long he'll last out there?
say:9:1120603006:1.source_cn: 荒漠、风沙、毒虫、烈日……你猜猜他能活多久？

say:10:1120603007:1.text: No... Please! I'm telling you, I really don't know anything about the treasure...!
say:10:1120603007:1.source_cn: 不……不要！求你们，求求你了，我……我真的不知道什么宝...

say:11:1120603008:1.text: He ain't talking, Boss! Quit wasting your time!
say:11:1120603008:1.source_cn: 老大，他还嘴硬！别跟他废话了！

say:15:1120603011:1.text: Hey, I recognize those two furballs! They're treasure-hunting hamsters!
say:15:1120603011:1.source_cn: 嗯？我认得那两只仓鼠！那是可以勘探宝藏所在地的寻宝仓鼠！

say:16:1120603012:1.text: Not bad! Didn't think these treasure hunters had such tough friends!
say:16:1120603012:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，不错，没想到这俩宝藏猎人的同伙自己凑上来了！

choice_prompt:17:1120603012.text: Not bad! Didn't think these treasure hunters had such tough friends!
choice_prompt:17:1120603012.source_cn: 嘿嘿，不错，没想到这俩宝藏猎人的同伙自己凑上来了！

say:18:1120603013:1.text: First, this tight-lipped jerk, and now some meddling idiot! I just need one of you alive to tell me what I want to know!
say:18:1120603013:1.source_cn: 嘴硬又喜欢多管闲事的家伙最可恨——既然这样，那就干掉你...

choice:17:0:1.text: Chippy and Hammie aren't treasure hunters.
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 满满和漫漫不是寻宝仓鼠
choice:17:0:1.male: Chippy and Hammie aren't treasure hunters.
choice:17:0:1.female: Chippy and Hammie aren't treasure hunters.

choice:17:1:2.text: You might want to get your eyes checked.
choice:17:1:2.male: You might want to get your eyes checked.
choice:17:1:2.female: You might want to get your eyes checked.

choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 你要是动手，我不会袖手旁观

choice:13:0:1.text: What's this I hear about a treasure?
choice:13:0:1.male: What's this I hear about a treasure?
choice:13:0:1.female: What's this I hear about a treasure?

choice:13:1:2.text: I'm here to save the day.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 放心吧，我又来见义勇为了
choice:13:1:2.male: I'm here to save the day.
choice:13:1:2.female: I'm here to save the day.

choice:13:2:3.text: Don't mind me. I'm just passing through...
choice:13:2:3.male: Don't mind me. I'm just passing through...
choice:13:2:3.female: Don't mind me. I'm just passing through...

say:1:1120604001:0.text: Thank you so much! Your hamster friends are incredible!
say:1:1120604001:0.source_cn: 太感谢了！你的仓鼠伙伴真厉害！
say:1:1120604001:0.male: Thank you so much! Your hamster friends are incredible!
say:1:1120604001:0.female: Thank you so much! Your hamster friends are incredible!

say:3:1120604002:1.text: We're grateful for your help. My name is Oldiler, and this is my brother Evan.
say:3:1120604002:1.source_cn: 感谢你的援手，我叫欧迪尔，这是我的弟弟艾文。
say:3:1120604002:1.male: We're grateful for your help. My name is Oldiler, and this is my brother Evan.
say:3:1120604002:1.female: We're grateful for your help. My name is Oldiler, and this is my brother Evan.

choice_prompt:4:1120604002.text: We're grateful for your help. My name is Oldiler, and this is my brother Evan.
choice_prompt:4:1120604002.source_cn: 感谢你的援手，我叫欧迪尔，这是我的弟弟艾文。
choice_prompt:4:1120604002.male: We're grateful for your help. My name is Oldiler, and this is my brother Evan.
choice_prompt:4:1120604002.female: We're grateful for your help. My name is Oldiler, and this is my brother Evan.

say:5:1120604003:1.text: A famous treasure hunter once said: "True treasure hunters must be able to feed their families with just their sense of smell."
say:5:1120604003:1.source_cn: 有位宝藏猎人说过：“真正的宝藏猎人，必须能凭借自己的嗅...
say:5:1120604003:1.male: A famous treasure hunter once said: "True treasure hunters must be able to feed their families with just their sense of smell."
say:5:1120604003:1.female: A famous treasure hunter once said: "True treasure hunters must be able to feed their families with just their sense of smell."

say:6:1120604004:1.text: In that respect, I suppose you could call us "treasure hunters".
say:6:1120604004:1.source_cn: 按照这个标准，我们只能“勉强”算是宝藏猎人。
say:6:1120604004:1.male: In that respect, I suppose you could call us "treasure hunters".
say:6:1120604004:1.female: In that respect, I suppose you could call us "treasure hunters".

say:7:1120604005:1.text: I'm ashamed to admit it, but this is our first time looking for treasure this far away from home.
say:7:1120604005:1.source_cn: 说来惭愧，其实这还是我们第一次离家这么远来寻宝。
say:7:1120604005:1.male: I'm ashamed to admit it, but this is our first time looking for treasure this far away from home.
say:7:1120604005:1.female: I'm ashamed to admit it, but this is our first time looking for treasure this far away from home.

say:8:1120604006:0.text: We only came here because we heard there was treasure in the area, but then we ran into those bandits...
say:8:1120604006:0.source_cn: 我们是听说这里有宝藏才赶来的，可没想到会被匪徒盯上……

say:12:1120604007:0.text: So you're not from around here, huh? No wonder your accent sounds so much different from everyone else's.
say:12:1120604007:0.source_cn: 原来你们不是本地人，怪不得口音听起来和这里的人一点都不像。

choice_prompt:13:1120604007.text: So you're not from around here, huh? No wonder your accent sounds so much different from everyone else's.
choice_prompt:13:1120604007.source_cn: 原来你们不是本地人，怪不得口音听起来和这里的人一点都不像。

say:14:1120604008:1.text: That was most likely my fault...

say:15:1120604009:1.text: The treasure those bandits were asking about... We made it all up back at a tavern in Alkali.
say:15:1120604009:1.source_cn: 刚才那两个匪徒打听的“英灵宝藏”，其实是我在咸水镇酒馆...

say:16:1120604010:1.text: You know how it goes, right? A warm fire, lots of drinks, a minstrel singing songs all night... It's easy to get carried away in that kind of place!
say:16:1120604010:1.source_cn: 你知道的，酒精、炉火，吟游诗人的小曲，在那种环境下，谁...

say:17:1120604011:1.text: I tried to convince the tavern keeper to waive our tab by making up a bunch of treasure-hunting stories. I even spun a tale about a legendary treasure and threw in some name that an old Mauler once told me: Lester.
say:17:1120604011:1.source_cn: 为了让酒馆老板免单，我编了很多寻宝时的“英勇事迹”，为...

say:18:1120604012:1.text: You've already seen the kind of trouble we're likely to find. Sorry we got you wrapped up in it.
say:18:1120604012:1.source_cn: 结果你们都看到了。让你们卷入其中，实在抱歉。

choice_prompt:19:1120604012.text: You've already seen the kind of trouble we're likely to find. Sorry we got you wrapped up in it.
choice_prompt:19:1120604012.source_cn: 结果你们都看到了。让你们卷入其中，实在抱歉。

say:21:1120604014:1.text: Come on, Evan! We still need to get our stuff back from those bandits!
say:21:1120604014:1.source_cn: 艾文，别发呆了，我们得把匪徒抢走的行李捡回来。

say:24:1120604016:1.text: To keep hunting for treasure, of course! We can't give up halfway through our first adventure away from home!
say:24:1120604016:1.source_cn: 当然是继续寻宝了！这是我们第一次离家来寻宝，怎么能半途而废。
say:24:1120604016:1.male: To keep hunting for treasure, of course! We can't give up halfway through our first adventure away from home!
say:24:1120604016:1.female: To keep hunting for treasure, of course! We can't give up halfway through our first adventure away from home!

say:25:1120604017:1.text: Sure, but we need to get our stuff back from those bandits first.
say:25:1120604017:1.source_cn: 好吧，不过我们得先把匪徒抢走的东西捡回来。
say:25:1120604017:1.male: Sure, but we need to get our stuff back from those bandits first.
say:25:1120604017:1.female: Sure, but we need to get our stuff back from those bandits first.

say:26:1120604018:1.text: Let's give them a hand, Magister!
say:26:1120604018:1.male: Let's give them a hand, Magister!
say:26:1120604018:1.female: Let's give them a hand, Magister!

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 匪徒为什么会盯上你们？

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 现在该说说宝藏的消息了吧！

say:0:1120605001:0.text: A compass, some rope, and some flint... This should be the stuff that the bandits stole from those treasure hunters.
say:0:1120605001:0.source_cn: 指南针、绳索、打火石……这些应该是那两个宝藏猎人的行李吧。
say:0:1120605001:0.male: A compass, some rope, and some flint... This should be the stuff that the bandits stole from those treasure hunters.
say:0:1120605001:0.female: A compass, some rope, and some flint... This should be the stuff that the bandits stole from those treasure hunters.

say:1:1120605002:0.text: There's more stuff up ahead. Let's go take a look!
say:1:1120605002:0.source_cn: 前面好像还有东西，我们再去那边找找！

say:0:1120606001:0.text: Jerky, cheese, a loaf of rye... This isn't exactly the most nutritious food, especially on long trips!
say:0:1120606001:0.source_cn: 肉干、奶酪、黑麦面包……呀，长期这样吃会缺乏维生素的！

say:1:1120606002:0.text: It still beats starving to death!

say:1:1120607002:0.text: We should remind them to stock up on fresh water.
say:1:1120607002:0.source_cn: 得提醒他们重新准备一些清水。
say:1:1120607002:0.male: We should remind them to stock up on fresh water.
say:1:1120607002:0.female: We should remind them to stock up on fresh water.

say:0:1120608001:0.text: That should be everything... Hmm? What's this?
say:0:1120608001:0.source_cn: 东西应该都找回来了……咦，这是什么？

say:1:1120608002:0.text: Let me see... It looks like a manuscript of some kind.
say:1:1120608002:0.source_cn: 让我看看……好像是本手稿。

say:2:1120608003:0.text: Maybe it belongs to the brothers. Let's go ask.
say:2:1120608003:0.source_cn: 或许是那对兄弟的收藏品？我们去问问吧。

say:1:1120609001:0.text: This manuscript... Where did you find it?
say:1:1120609001:0.source_cn: 这手稿……你们是在哪里找到的？

say:3:1120609002:0.text: We found it on the bandits we defeated just now. Chippy wonders what's written there...
say:3:1120609002:0.source_cn: 就在刚才被我们打倒的盗匪身上。这手稿上写的是什么啊……

say:5:1120609003:0.text: I can't read it either. Most of it has been blurred out, and the only legible parts are all scrambled up! Almost like a code...
say:5:1120609003:0.source_cn: 漫漫也读不懂。很多字都模糊不清，能看清楚的那些还被刻意...

say:6:1120609004:1.text: Wait a minute! This handwriting and the way it's encrypted... No way... Evan, come look at this!
say:6:1120609004:1.source_cn: 这字迹和加密方式……这该不会是……艾文，你快来看看！

say:9:1120609005:0.text: What?! But how could this be?!

say:10:1120609006:0.text: What's the matter? Is something wrong with the manuscript?
say:10:1120609006:0.source_cn: 嗯？你们在说什么？这张手稿有什么不对吗？

say:11:1120609007:0.text: We were just saying that this handwriting... It looks just like our father's!
say:11:1120609007:0.source_cn: 我们是说，这字迹……像是我们父亲的！

say:14:1120609008:0.text: Are you sure it's not just a coincidence?

say:15:1120609009:0.text: Our father was also a treasure hunter. His last adventure led him to the Eroded Enclave, and we haven't heard from him ever since...
say:15:1120609009:0.source_cn: 我们的父亲也是名宝藏猎人，他最后一次寻宝就是来风蚀飞地...

say:16:1120609010:0.text: Our neighbors kept saying that he abandoned us, but Oldiler and I never believed it for one second! Our father's not that kind of person!
say:16:1120609010:0.source_cn: 邻居总会悄悄地议论，说父亲抛弃了我们。欧迪尔和我都不相...

say:17:1120609011:1.text: The truth is I've never cared much for this profession because of my father, but I don't know what else to do with myself.
say:17:1120609011:1.source_cn: ……因为父亲的关系，我并不喜欢做这一行，可我也不知道自...

say:18:1120609012:1.text: I, on the other hand, think being a treasure hunter is great! It pays well sometimes, and it might even lead us to our father someday!
say:18:1120609012:1.source_cn: 我倒是觉得当个宝藏猎人挺不错的，能发财，说不定还能找到...

choice_prompt:19:1120609012.text: I, on the other hand, think being a treasure hunter is great! It pays well sometimes, and it might even lead us to our father someday!
choice_prompt:19:1120609012.source_cn: 我倒是觉得当个宝藏猎人挺不错的，能发财，说不定还能找到父亲的踪迹。

say:20:1120609013:1.text: You're right. This might be our best shot at finding our father... At the very least, it means he's been through here before.
say:20:1120609013:1.source_cn: 的确，这份手稿或许是我们找到父亲的契机……这说明他一定...

say:21:1120609014:1.text: But so much of the writing has been blurred away...
say:21:1120609014:1.source_cn: 可手稿上面的字已经模糊不清了……

say:22:1120609015:0.text: I know a recipe for a magic detergent that might clear things up for us!
say:22:1120609015:0.source_cn: 漫漫知道一种魔法清洁剂，或许有用！

say:25:1120609016:1.text: But we're in the middle of the desert! Where are we supposed to find the materials to make it?
say:25:1120609016:1.source_cn: 可是，这里是荒漠，到哪里去找制作魔法清洁剂的材料？

say:26:1120609017:1.text: Don't worry. The pit of a <style="highlight">sandstone nut</style> can be extracted and used as a substitute for making the magic detergent.

say:27:1120609018:1.text: Really?! And here Chippy thought sandstone nuts were only good for snacking.
say:27:1120609018:1.source_cn: 什么？！满满还以为荒漠盐津仁只能当零食吃呢！

choice:19:1:2.text: You might be able to find him if you crack the code.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 或许破解手稿就能找到他
choice:19:1:2.male: You might be able to find him if you crack the code.
choice:19:1:2.female: You might be able to find him if you crack the code.

say:0:1120610001:0.text: Think these are enough sandstone nuts, Magister?
say:0:1120610001:0.source_cn: 主人，这些盐津仁应该够了吧？
say:0:1120610001:0.male: Think these are enough sandstone nuts, Magister?
say:0:1120610001:0.female: Think these are enough sandstone nuts, Magister?

say:1:1120610002:0.text: Looks like it to me! Let's head back.
say:1:1120610002:0.male: Looks like it to me! Let's head back.
say:1:1120610002:0.female: Looks like it to me! Let's head back.

say:3:1120611001:0.text: The rest of the materials are ready. All I need now are some sandstone nuts, and I can make my magic detergent!
say:3:1120611001:0.source_cn: 别的材料我都准备好了，只要有盐津仁就可以调配魔法清洁剂啦！
say:3:1120611001:0.male: The rest of the materials are ready. All I need now are some sandstone nuts, and I can make my magic detergent!
say:3:1120611001:0.female: The rest of the materials are ready. All I need now are some sandstone nuts, and I can make my magic detergent!

choice_prompt:4:1120611001.text: The rest of the materials are ready. All I need now are some sandstone nuts, and I can make my magic detergent!
choice_prompt:4:1120611001.source_cn: 别的材料我都准备好了，只要有盐津仁就可以调配魔法清洁剂啦！
choice_prompt:4:1120611001.male: The rest of the materials are ready. All I need now are some sandstone nuts, and I can make my magic detergent!
choice_prompt:4:1120611001.female: The rest of the materials are ready. All I need now are some sandstone nuts, and I can make my magic detergent!

say:5:1120611002:1.text: Good! Now, I need to crush the sandstone nuts... then I add just a little wolfsbane juice... and finally...
say:5:1120611002:1.source_cn: 嗯……捣碎盐津仁，加入少量附子草汁……然后……

say:6:1120611003:1.text: It's done! Go ahead and give it a try!

say:7:1120611004:1.text: The detergent really works... Look, Oldiler, I'm almost certain this is our father's handwriting!
say:7:1120611004:1.source_cn: 清洁剂确实有效……这……这应该就是父亲的字迹！

say:8:1120611005:1.text: You're right! Father always had a tendency to slant his writing towards the left, just like in the manuscript!
say:8:1120611005:1.source_cn: 没错，父亲写字母的时候总是习惯向左边倾斜，和手稿上的字...
say:8:1120611005:1.male: You're right! Father always had a tendency to slant his writing towards the left, just like in the manuscript!
say:8:1120611005:1.female: You're right! Father always had a tendency to slant his writing towards the left, just like in the manuscript!

choice_prompt:9:1120611005.text: You're right! Father always had a tendency to slant his writing towards the left, just like in the manuscript!
choice_prompt:9:1120611005.source_cn: 没错，父亲写字母的时候总是习惯向左边倾斜，和手稿上的字迹一模一样！
choice_prompt:9:1120611005.male: You're right! Father always had a tendency to slant his writing towards the left, just like in the manuscript!
choice_prompt:9:1120611005.female: You're right! Father always had a tendency to slant his writing towards the left, just like in the manuscript!

say:10:1120611006:1.text: "... I'm so excited that I can hardly bear it. The treasure appears to be somewhere nearby... It may be my greatest discovery yet!"
say:10:1120611006:1.source_cn: “……我现在十分激动，宝物似乎就藏在此处……这可是大发现！”

say:11:1120611007:1.text: There are also two different locations marked here...
say:11:1120611007:1.source_cn: 在文字下面，还重点标记了两个位置……

say:12:1120611008:1.text: Could the treasure be in one of those two places? Dura above, Father must've blessed us with this, Oldiler!
say:12:1120611008:1.source_cn: 难道是宝藏可能所在的地点？艾雅在上，哥哥，这一定是父亲...

say:13:1120611009:1.text: Aside from possibly finding him... We might also find this priceless treasure!
say:13:1120611009:1.source_cn: 或许我们这次真的能找到他……连带收获一批财富！

say:14:1120611010:1.text: I have just the story for you... "The treasure hunter's sons, bold and true. With their father's guidance, they knew what to do. They left their home with dreams in their eyes. In pursuit of treasures under distant skies."
say:14:1120611010:1.source_cn: “宝藏猎人的两个儿子，远离故乡。在父亲的指引下，找到宝藏！”

say:15:1120611011:1.text: "A gleaming field of gold they chanced to find. With twenty ironjaws, their fortune entwined. Hauling back their wealth, they journeyed without lack. Homebound they returned, never to look back."
say:15:1120611011:1.source_cn: “金币像成片的麦穗，丰收光芒将眼眸点亮。二十只钢颚兽驮...

say:16:1120611012:1.text: "To neighbors spreading rumors, heed this call. Open wide and let truth befall."
say:16:1120611012:1.source_cn: “那些以为两兄弟被抛弃的邻居们啊，请将你们的嘴张大。”

say:17:1120611013:1.text: "Swallow those rumors, don't act hurt. Eat your words, then go eat dirt."
say:17:1120611013:1.source_cn: “请你们将那些传出的流言，追回，然后吞下。”

choice_prompt:18:1120611013.text: "Swallow those rumors, don't act hurt. Eat your words, then go eat dirt."
choice_prompt:18:1120611013.source_cn: “请你们将那些传出的流言，追回，然后吞下。”

say:19:1120611014:1.text: We should've become bards... Anyway, would you like to come with us?
say:19:1120611014:1.source_cn: 你们也要去一起寻宝吗？

say:20:1120611015:1.text: With your help, as well as the help of your hamsters, I'm sure we'll have a much easier time finding the treasure!
say:20:1120611015:1.source_cn: 有你和你的这两只仓鼠伙伴，我们寻宝的过程一定会容易很多。
say:20:1120611015:1.male: With your help, as well as the help of your hamsters, I'm sure we'll have a much easier time finding the treasure!
say:20:1120611015:1.female: With your help, as well as the help of your hamsters, I'm sure we'll have a much easier time finding the treasure!

say:21:1120611016:1.text: If we manage to find it, we'll give you a fourth... No, a third of the treasure for helping us out!
say:21:1120611016:1.source_cn: 如果寻找到宝藏，我们愿意分出宝藏的四分……三分之一，感...

say:24:1120611017:1.text: Now you're speaking our language! Let's move out!
say:24:1120611017:1.source_cn: 听起来更令人心动了！我们快出发吧！

say:3:1120612001:1.text: Is this really one of the marked locations? It doesn't seem like there's anything here...
say:3:1120612001:1.source_cn: 这就是手稿里标记的地方吗？可这里什么也没有……

say:5:1120612003:1.text: Hey, you remember what those bandits said about our hamster friends? Why were they so certain about them being treasure hunters?
say:5:1120612003:1.source_cn: 还记得那些匪徒提到寻宝仓鼠的事吗？他们为什么会笃定咱们...

say:6:1120612004:1.text: Well, obviously, it's because all hamsters... Never mind... Do you think the treasure might be buried underground?
say:6:1120612004:1.source_cn: 当然是因为……你是说，宝藏可能藏在地下？

say:7:1120612005:1.text: I'm not sure, but we could always try digging around the area?
say:7:1120612005:1.source_cn: 虽然不能确定，但我们可以在这附近挖挖看。

say:8:1120612006:1.text: Then let's get to work! You guys can just leave it to us and look around elsewhere!
say:8:1120612006:1.source_cn: 那我们赶快动工吧！这里我们来，你们去其他地方看看！

say:9:1120612007:1.text: And don't worry, you'll get your share of whatever we find!
say:9:1120612007:1.source_cn: 放心，不管找到什么，一定都有你们一份！

say:0:1120613001:0.text: Something tells me it won't be that simple...
say:0:1120613001:0.source_cn: 总感觉事情不会这么简单……
say:0:1120613001:0.male: Something tells me it won't be that simple...
say:0:1120613001:0.female: Something tells me it won't be that simple...

say:1:1120613002:0.text: Looks like you were right, Magister. There's nothing here at all!
say:1:1120613002:0.source_cn: 呀，主人猜的好准，这里什么都没有！
say:1:1120613002:0.male: Looks like you were right, Magister. There's nothing here at all!
say:1:1120613002:0.female: Looks like you were right, Magister. There's nothing here at all!

say:0:1120614001:0.text: It looks like nothing's buried here...
say:0:1120614001:0.source_cn: 这里看起来不像埋了东西的样子……

say:1:1120614002:0.text: *Sigh*... Finding treasure can never be easy, can it?
say:1:1120614002:0.source_cn: 唉，宝藏果然不是那么好找的。

say:1:1120615002:0.text: Get out of the way, Evan! Ugh...

say:2:1120615003:0.text: What's going on with the brothers? Let's go take a look!
say:2:1120615003:0.source_cn: 那俩兄弟怎么了？！我们快过去看看！

say:1:1120616001:0.text: Be careful. There's something lurking in the sand... A creature of some sort. It came out and attacked us.
say:1:1120616001:0.source_cn: 小心，沙子里有什么东西……某种动物。我们被咬伤了。

say:3:1120616002:0.text: It's a lair for desert scorpions!

choice_prompt:4:1120616002.text: It's a lair for desert scorpions!

say:6:1120616003:0.text: The sting doesn't hurt. In fact... I don't feel anything at all. Does that mean we're okay?
say:6:1120616003:0.source_cn: 伤口一点也不痛，不如说是……毫无感觉。这是不是说明没什么事？

say:7:1120616004:0.text: No, it doesn't! Desert scorpions have extremely powerful neurotoxins that can cause paralysis and even heart failure...
say:7:1120616004:0.source_cn: 沙漠毒蝎的毒性很强！毒液进入血液，会让肢体麻痹，最严重...

say:8:1120616005:0.text: What?! Hurry up, Oldiler, we have to cut our wounds open and squeeze out the venom!
say:8:1120616005:0.source_cn: 什么？！欧迪尔，快把伤口划破，把毒液挤出来！

say:9:1120616006:0.text: ... It's no good, I can't feel my hands anymore.

choice_prompt:10:1120616006.text: ... It's no good, I can't feel my hands anymore.

say:11:1120616007:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right! Before we came to the Eroded Enclave, I read up on all the local flora and fauna, just in case something like this happened!
say:11:1120616007:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right! Before we came to the Eroded Enclave, I read up on all the local flora and fauna, just in case something like this happened!
say:11:1120616007:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right! Before we came to the Eroded Enclave, I read up on all the local flora and fauna, just in case something like this happened!

say:12:1120616008:1.text: If I remember correctly, the <style="highlight">scorpion stinger</style> contains a type of liquid that can contain and neutralize scorpion venom.
say:12:1120616008:1.source_cn: 我想想……记得风土志上说，<style=highlig...
say:12:1120616008:1.male: If I remember correctly, the <style="highlight">scorpion stinger</style> contains a type of liquid that can contain and neutralize scorpion venom.
say:12:1120616008:1.female: If I remember correctly, the <style="highlight">scorpion stinger</style> contains a type of liquid that can contain and neutralize scorpion venom.

say:13:1120616009:1.text: For now, we can also fight fire with fire by using another type of poison to slow its spread.
say:13:1120616009:1.source_cn: 另外，也可以先用以毒攻毒的方法，用其他毒液先抑制蝎毒蔓延。
say:13:1120616009:1.male: For now, we can also fight fire with fire by using another type of poison to slow its spread.
say:13:1120616009:1.female: For now, we can also fight fire with fire by using another type of poison to slow its spread.

say:15:1120616010:1.text: Stay here with your brother, Evan! We'll be back with antivenom in no time!
say:15:1120616010:1.source_cn: 艾文，你和欧迪尔就在这里休息一下吧，我们找到解药就回来！

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 要是能找到解毒剂的话……

say:0:1120617001:0.text: There should be plenty of spiders and scorpion stingers around here...
say:0:1120617001:0.source_cn: 褐刺掌和蜘蛛，应该这附近就有吧……

say:0:1120618001:0.text: Good, it looks like we have everything we need!

say:1:1120618002:0.text: I hope we're not too late! Let's hurry back!
say:1:1120618002:0.source_cn: 咱们快回去吧，希望还来得及！

say:3:1120619001:1.source_cn: 药膏敷上之后，感觉怎么样？

say:4:1120619002:1.text: The sting is starting to cool down... Hey, I can feel my hands again!
say:4:1120619002:1.source_cn: 伤口处清清凉凉……哦，我的手有知觉了！

say:5:1120619003:1.text: I feel less dizzy now, too... Looks like it's working pretty well.
say:5:1120619003:1.source_cn: 眩晕感也减轻了许多……看来，很有效果。

choice_prompt:6:1120619003.text: I feel less dizzy now, too... Looks like it's working pretty well.
choice_prompt:6:1120619003.source_cn: 眩晕感也减轻了许多……看来，很有效果。

say:7:1120619004:1.text: Of course! The heroes always have to go through a few hardships before they can emerge victorious!
say:7:1120619004:1.source_cn: 当然！戏剧中的主人翁，在成功之前都要经历一番艰辛。

say:8:1120619005:1.text: "To appreciate the beauty of the peak, you must scale the mountain you seek."
say:8:1120619005:1.source_cn: “要欣赏山巅美景，需先行过崎岖的山路”。
say:8:1120619005:1.male: "To appreciate the beauty of the peak, you must scale the mountain you seek."
say:8:1120619005:1.female: "To appreciate the beauty of the peak, you must scale the mountain you seek."

say:9:1120619006:1.text: No one wants to listen to a story with no danger... And as the heroes of this story, Oldiler and I have an obligation to make it exciting!
say:9:1120619006:1.source_cn: 太顺利的故事无法吸引观众——而这出寻宝历险记，我和欧迪...
say:9:1120619006:1.male: No one wants to listen to a story with no danger... And as the heroes of this story, Oldiler and I have an obligation to make it exciting!
say:9:1120619006:1.female: No one wants to listen to a story with no danger... And as the heroes of this story, Oldiler and I have an obligation to make it exciting!

say:10:1120619007:1.text: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
say:10:1120619007:1.source_cn: 说起来，我竟然开始慢慢喜欢这里了……这让我自己都难以想象。
say:10:1120619007:1.male: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
say:10:1120619007:1.female: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.

choice_prompt:11:1120619007.text: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
choice_prompt:11:1120619007.source_cn: 说起来，我竟然开始慢慢喜欢这里了……这让我自己都难以想象。
choice_prompt:11:1120619007.male: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
choice_prompt:11:1120619007.female: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.

say:12:1120619008:1.text: I don't like being far away from home. Maybe it's because of our father's disappearance...
say:12:1120619008:1.source_cn: 我不喜欢远离家乡的感觉。或许是因为父亲失踪的缘故……
say:12:1120619008:1.male: I don't like being far away from home. Maybe it's because of our father's disappearance...
say:12:1120619008:1.female: I don't like being far away from home. Maybe it's because of our father's disappearance...

say:13:1120619009:1.text: But after our run-ins with bandits and poisonous scorpions, I realized something important. We'd never have experienced any of this if we had just stayed home.
say:13:1120619009:1.source_cn: 但来到这里才发现，虽然经历了匪徒和毒蝎，但如果蜗居在家...
say:13:1120619009:1.male: But after our run-ins with bandits and poisonous scorpions, I realized something important. We'd never have experienced any of this if we had just stayed home.
say:13:1120619009:1.female: But after our run-ins with bandits and poisonous scorpions, I realized something important. We'd never have experienced any of this if we had just stayed home.

say:14:1120619010:1.text: Being far from home isn't as scary as I thought. In fact, it's even a little exciting.
say:14:1120619010:1.source_cn: 远方并没有想象中的那么可怕。甚至可以说，很有趣。
say:14:1120619010:1.male: Being far from home isn't as scary as I thought. In fact, it's even a little exciting.
say:14:1120619010:1.female: Being far from home isn't as scary as I thought. In fact, it's even a little exciting.

say:17:1120619012:1.text: Me? I'm more excited about finding that buried treasure, and what we'll do with it after bringing it home.
say:17:1120619012:1.source_cn: 我？我更期待从这片沙漠之下挖出宝藏后的事情——就像我之...

say:18:1120619013:1.text: "Though the brothers saw many wonderful things along the way, what captivated them most was reaching home to stay!"
say:18:1120619013:1.source_cn: “相比于路途中偶尔的美景，终点才是令他魂牵梦绕的彼方！”

say:19:1120619014:1.text: Also... this is a chance for us to find our father. Even though he left without a word... I still miss him.
say:19:1120619014:1.source_cn: 而且……这也是我们找到父亲的契机。虽然他没留下只言片语...

say:20:1120619015:1.text: So do I, Oldiler. In all of the stories he told us, the heroes always chose their path and their destination.
say:20:1120619015:1.source_cn: 我也是，哥哥。无数的故事告诉我们：选择了一条路的同时，...

say:21:1120619016:1.text: We may be a little battered and dizzy, but our choice is still the same. We'll keep going!
say:21:1120619016:1.source_cn: 而现在，我的头虽然还有些晕，但我还是选择——继续前进！

choice:11:1:2.text: You don't like the Eroded Enclave?
choice:11:1:2.male: You don't like the Eroded Enclave?
choice:11:1:2.female: You don't like the Eroded Enclave?

choice:6:0:1.text: Are you going to keep searching for the treasure?
choice:6:0:1.male: Are you going to keep searching for the treasure?
choice:6:0:1.female: Are you going to keep searching for the treasure?

say:0:1120620001:0.text: This place truly is beautiful, especially the sunset. We can't see anything like that in our hometown.
say:0:1120620001:0.source_cn: 这里的风景可真壮美，尤其是落日时分。我们的家乡是见不到...

say:1:1120620002:0.text: "As the hunter gazed at the setting sun over the desert sand, his heart suddenly began to stir at everything so grand."
say:1:1120620002:0.source_cn: “猎手塞雷克看着荒漠的落日，心里突然涌起了一阵冲动”。

say:2:1120620003:0.text: "He felt the urge to gallop, to outpace the scorching sun and return to the moment when the gunfire sounded done."
say:2:1120620003:0.source_cn: “他要策马奔驰，跑得比骄阳与黄沙更快，重新回到枪声刚刚...

say:1:1120621002:0.text: I think someone's passed out over there...

say:2:1120621003:0.text: Maybe due to dehydration? Come on, let's go see if we can help.
say:2:1120621003:0.source_cn: 难道是脱水症？我们去看看吧，说不定能帮上一把。

say:4:1120622002:1.text: Did you folks save me just now? Thanks...
say:4:1120622002:1.source_cn: 是你们救了我吗，谢谢你们……

choice_prompt:5:1120622002.text: Did you folks save me just now? Thanks...
choice_prompt:5:1120622002.source_cn: 是你们救了我吗，谢谢你们……

say:6:1120622003:1.text: I heard there was plenty of money to be made out here, so I came to stay with some friends to find work. The name's Chezzig, by the way.
say:6:1120622003:1.source_cn: 我……我叫切西格，听说在这里无论做什么都很赚钱，就从家...

say:7:1120622004:1.text: Damn those bandits! They jumped me before I had taken two steps out of Alkali!
say:7:1120622004:1.source_cn: 可那群天杀的劫匪！出了咸水镇没多久，我就被他们给劫啦！

say:8:1120622005:1.text: They took my valuables before knocking me out and leaving me here to die!
say:8:1120622005:1.source_cn: 他们抢了我的财物，还把我打晕，丢在这里自生自灭！

say:9:1120622006:1.text: Bandits again?! I remember people saying that Alkali's supposed to be a simple, peaceful town...
say:9:1120622006:1.source_cn: 又是匪徒！唉，我记得还有人说咸水镇是个民风淳朴的地方呢……

say:10:1120622007:1.text: I'm supposed to meet my friends up ahead, but now that I'm broke, bruised, and on the brink of starvation...
say:10:1120622007:1.source_cn: 我和朋友本来约好在前面碰面，可现在我身无分文，浑身又疼...

say:11:1120622008:1.text: You shouldn't be traveling if you're hurt. You need to find a safe place to rest.
say:11:1120622008:1.source_cn: 你受了伤，最好不要急着赶路，我们找个地方先休息一下吧。

say:12:1120622009:1.text: There should be a safe place just up the road, but there's no food or water out here. I'd do anything for a cup of blazing orchid right now...
say:12:1120622009:1.source_cn: 前面不远应该有可以休息的地方。可惜啊，这地方太荒芜了，...

say:17:1120622010:0.text: You ran into bandits out here, huh...?

choice:5:0:1.text: Why were you lying on the ground?
choice:5:0:1.male: Why were you lying on the ground?
choice:5:0:1.female: Why were you lying on the ground?

narration:0:1120623001:1.text: The party arrives at the clearing that Chezzig mentioned. Everyone stops to rest.

say:2:1120624001:1.text: You noticed it too, right? Chezzig's eyes kept wandering around while he was talking.
say:2:1120624001:1.source_cn: 你们注意到了吗？切西格刚才说话时眼神飘忽不定。

say:3:1120624002:1.text: It didn't seem like he had just woken up. If anything, it looked like he was hiding something.
say:3:1120624002:1.source_cn: 那不是刚苏醒过来的恍惚，更像是心虚。

say:4:1120624003:1.text: Really? I didn't notice anything... You sure you're not overthinking it?
say:4:1120624003:1.source_cn: 什么，哪有？你一定是多心了！

say:5:1120624004:1.text: If I had just woken up in the middle of a life-threatening situation, I'd probably act the same. Checking my surroundings left and right.
say:5:1120624004:1.source_cn: 要是我刚刚从灾难中醒过来，眼睛也不会直瞧着同一个地方！...

say:7:1120624006:1.text: What do you make of it, friend?
say:7:1120624006:1.male: What do you make of it, friend?
say:7:1120624006:1.female: What do you make of it, friend?

choice_prompt:8:1120624006.text: What do you make of it, friend?
choice_prompt:8:1120624006.male: What do you make of it, friend?
choice_prompt:8:1120624006.female: What do you make of it, friend?

say:9:1120624007:1.text: He also seems fairly familiar with the area. He even knows where the safest place is.
say:9:1120624007:1.source_cn: 而且他似乎对这片地方很熟悉，知道哪里可以休息……
say:9:1120624007:1.male: He also seems fairly familiar with the area. He even knows where the safest place is.
say:9:1120624007:1.female: He also seems fairly familiar with the area. He even knows where the safest place is.

say:10:1120624009:1.text: We have already run into plenty of traps. It wouldn't hurt to be a little more cautious, so let's just keep an eye on him...
say:10:1120624009:1.source_cn: 咱们这一路踩的陷阱够多了，还是警惕些好。得找个机会试探...

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 突然在路上遇到，是很蹊跷

say:12:1120624008:1.text: That's right! That guy got attacked by bandits, just like us! If you ask me, he's just another unfortunate soul out here in the desert.
say:12:1120624008:1.source_cn: 就是这个道理！刚才那兄弟也是被匪徒袭击了，和我和欧迪尔...

choice:8:1:2.text: Found you two in a similar way.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 我救你们的时候也很凑巧
choice:8:1:2.male: Found you two in a similar way.
choice:8:1:2.female: Found you two in a similar way.

say:3:1120625001:1.text: Hey, you two! Come over here and rest your legs!
say:3:1120625001:1.source_cn: 嘿，两位，快来好好休息一会儿吧。

say:4:1120625002:1.text: What were you guys talking about?

choice_prompt:5:1120625002.text: What were you guys talking about?

say:6:1120625003:1.text: "Important business," eh? You folks wouldn't happen to be treasure hunters, would you?
say:6:1120625003:1.source_cn: 重要的事……你们几个，是宝藏猎人吧？那说的难道是……

say:7:1120625004:1.text: That's right. We were reassessing our current situation, as well as discussing our next steps.
say:7:1120625004:1.source_cn: 是的，除了确定行进方向，我们还重新评估了藏宝点的情况。

say:8:1120625005:1.text: We've already confirmed that this treasure is huge! We'll need at least twenty ironjaws just to carry it all back to our hometown!
say:8:1120625005:1.source_cn: 已经确认了，那绝对是非常丰厚的宝藏！我们或许真的需要二...

say:9:1120625006:1.text: T-Twenty ironjaws?! Just to haul it back?!
say:9:1120625006:1.source_cn: 二十只钢颚兽才能搬走的宝藏？！

say:10:1120625007:1.text: That's one incredible discovery, my friends! I'm thrilled for you, though I can't say I'm not jealous either.
say:10:1120625007:1.source_cn: 那真是令人惊喜的发现！真是太好了！不，我是说，真羡慕你们啊！

say:11:1120625008:1.text: Are we feeling rested yet? If so, we should get going.
say:11:1120625008:1.source_cn: 朋友，休息够了吗？该出发了。

say:12:1120625009:1.text: Me? O-Of course I'm fine... Never felt better, in fact!
say:12:1120625009:1.source_cn: 我？当然，当然……我现在精神焕发！

say:13:1120625010:1.text: Onward, friends! To a vast fortune and a bright future!
say:13:1120625010:1.source_cn: 前行，前行！向着宝藏，向着友谊，也向着希望！

choice_prompt:14:1120625010.text: Onward, friends! To a vast fortune and a bright future!
choice_prompt:14:1120625010.source_cn: 前行，前行！向着宝藏，向着友谊，也向着希望！

say:20:1120625012:1.text: Don't worry. We know what to do.

say:21:1120625013:1.text: Ah, the treasure... It would be nice if we managed to find it along the way...
say:21:1120625013:1.source_cn: 宝藏啊……要是能顺路见识一下不就巧了吗……

choice_prompt:22:1120625013.text: Ah, the treasure... It would be nice if we managed to find it along the way...
choice_prompt:22:1120625013.source_cn: 宝藏啊……要是能顺路见识一下不就巧了吗……

say:23:1120625014:1.text: O-Of course! Meeting with my friends is still my highest priority!
say:23:1120625014:1.source_cn: 啊，是。当然还是先和朋友汇合更重要。
say:23:1120625014:1.male: O-Of course! Meeting with my friends is still my highest priority!
say:23:1120625014:1.female: O-Of course! Meeting with my friends is still my highest priority!

say:24:1120625015:1.text: I remember it's this way. Let's go.

choice:5:1:2.female: We were talking about the treasure.

say:3:1120626001:0.text: This is where you're supposed to meet your friends, right, Chezzig? Where are they?
say:3:1120626001:0.source_cn: 切西格，你说的汇合地就是这里吧，你的朋友呢？

say:4:1120626002:0.text: My friends? Ha! They're already here.

say:5:1120626003:0.text: You, my treasure-seeking friends, are gonna make me filthy rich! Thanks for coming all this way with me!
say:5:1120626003:0.source_cn: 你们——我宝贵的朋友，金子铸成的风向标！感谢你们愿意来这里！

say:10:1120626006:0.text: You're a lot slower than your friend here, aren't you, Evan?
say:10:1120626006:0.source_cn: 艾文，你的反应可比旁边这位朋友迟钝多了。

say:11:1120626007:0.text: For someone as slow-witted as you to defeat Puba and the others... I really don't know how you did it.
say:11:1120626007:0.source_cn: 就凭你这后知后觉的反应……真不知道你们是怎么干掉蒲巴他们的。

say:12:1120626008:0.text: It took a lot of effort to drag you halfwits out here, so don't think you're gonna escape.
say:12:1120626008:0.source_cn: 我费了这么大力气，总算把你们带到这里了。这次你们别想跑了。

say:13:1120626009:0.text: You're with the bandits who attacked us before...?
say:13:1120626009:0.source_cn: 你和之前抢劫我们的匪徒……是一伙的？

say:14:1120626010:1.text: I knew it! You're their leader, aren't you?!
say:14:1120626010:1.source_cn: 果然，你才是那些盗匪的首领！

say:15:1120626011:0.text: That's right, now tell me where to find the treasure! You put me in a good mood after telling me about this twenty ironjaw load of treasure, so I might just spare your lives if you cooperate...
say:15:1120626011:0.source_cn: 宝藏在哪儿？等我拿到“二十只钢颚兽才能驮动的宝藏”，心...

say:17:1120626013:0.text: Not willing to talk? Or do you still think you can get away? Ha! With our numbers, you're done for!
say:17:1120626013:0.source_cn: 不说话？打逃跑的主意？哈哈哈，我们的人很多，你们是跑不掉的！

say:2:1120629001:1.text: The journey to become a real treasure hunter is a lot different from what I had imagined...
say:2:1120629001:1.source_cn: 看起来宝藏猎人的职业旅途和我想的并不一样……
say:2:1120629001:1.male: The journey to become a real treasure hunter is a lot different from what I had imagined...
say:2:1120629001:1.female: The journey to become a real treasure hunter is a lot different from what I had imagined...

choice_prompt:3:1120629001.female: The journey to become a real treasure hunter is a lot different from what I had imagined...

say:4:1120629002:1.text: I'm fine... I just have a deeper understanding of what it means to be a treasure hunter now.
say:4:1120629002:1.source_cn: 我还好……只是对于宝藏猎人这个职业，我有了更深刻的认知。
say:4:1120629002:1.male: I'm fine... I just have a deeper understanding of what it means to be a treasure hunter now.
say:4:1120629002:1.female: I'm fine... I just have a deeper understanding of what it means to be a treasure hunter now.

say:5:1120629003:1.text: Insatiable greed, survival of the fittest... I was so caught up in the game that I lost my ability to tell truth from lies.
say:5:1120629003:1.source_cn: 贪婪、弱肉强食……陷入其中的我甚至分不清哪些是真实，哪...
say:5:1120629003:1.male: Insatiable greed, survival of the fittest... I was so caught up in the game that I lost my ability to tell truth from lies.
say:5:1120629003:1.female: Insatiable greed, survival of the fittest... I was so caught up in the game that I lost my ability to tell truth from lies.

say:6:1120629004:1.text: I never expected this to become a part of my story, too.
say:6:1120629004:1.source_cn: 这些都是我故事里从未设想过的另一部分真实。
say:6:1120629004:1.male: I never expected this to become a part of my story, too.
say:6:1120629004:1.female: I never expected this to become a part of my story, too.

choice_prompt:7:1120629004.male: I never expected this to become a part of my story, too.
choice_prompt:7:1120629004.female: I never expected this to become a part of my story, too.

say:8:1120629005:1.text: The same as the stories I grew up with... Roaming freely across the land in search of treasure, telling stories in taverns, and singing drunk songs with strangers all night.
say:8:1120629005:1.source_cn: 像我之前故事里的那样：寻宝时在广阔的天地间自由自在，在...
say:8:1120629005:1.male: The same as the stories I grew up with... Roaming freely across the land in search of treasure, telling stories in taverns, and singing drunk songs with strangers all night.
say:8:1120629005:1.female: The same as the stories I grew up with... Roaming freely across the land in search of treasure, telling stories in taverns, and singing drunk songs with strangers all night.

say:9:1120629006:1.text: But the truth is that danger and treasure-hunting go hand-in-hand.
say:9:1120629006:1.source_cn: 但现实中的寻宝，危险同时难以避免。

say:10:1120629007:1.text: I knew treasure hunters ran into their share of trouble, but I figured the worst of it was poisonous scorpions and the like...
say:10:1120629007:1.source_cn: 我知道宝藏猎人可能会遇见危险，但我一直以为最多是像毒蝎...

say:11:1120629008:1.text: I didn't realize that the greatest danger was the greed of the people around you. After all, the strong eat the weak out here...
say:11:1120629008:1.source_cn: 而不会是像现在这样，在弱肉强食的规则里，需要时刻警惕阴...

choice_prompt:12:1120629008.text: I didn't realize that the greatest danger was the greed of the people around you. After all, the strong eat the weak out here...
choice_prompt:12:1120629008.source_cn: 而不会是像现在这样，在弱肉强食的规则里，需要时刻警惕阴谋，分辨身边的贪婪。

say:13:1120629009:1.text: But treasure hunters can never live exactly like they do in the stories.
say:13:1120629009:1.source_cn: 但是宝藏猎人不可能活得和故事一样。

say:14:1120629010:1.text: You're right. After everything we've been through, I'm starting to see Father's views in a different light...
say:14:1120629010:1.source_cn: 是的，在经历过这些后，我对于父亲的看法，也开始变得复杂……

say:15:1120629011:1.text: I still resent him for leaving us to fend for ourselves, but I want to find him even more now.
say:15:1120629011:1.source_cn: 我仍然怨恨他一去不回，留下我们兄弟二人独自生活，可我现...

say:16:1120629012:1.text: After being gone for so long... I guess I do miss him a little. I also want to know how all of this came to happen.
say:16:1120629012:1.source_cn: 或许……在他失踪这么久后，我有些想他了。他也面对了我们...

say:17:1120629013:1.text: Let's keep searching his manuscript for clues, Evan. I'm sure we'll find him soon enough.
say:17:1120629013:1.source_cn: 继续沿着手稿上的线索寻找吧，我们一定会找到他的，艾文。

choice:12:0:1.text: Your story is more interesting now.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 听起来，还是你的故事更有趣些
choice:12:0:1.male: Your story is more interesting now.
choice:12:0:1.female: Your story is more interesting now.

choice:7:0:1.text: What did you imagine it would be like?
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 你想象中的宝藏猎人是什么样？
choice:7:0:1.male: What did you imagine it would be like?
choice:7:0:1.female: What did you imagine it would be like?

say:0:1120630001:0.text: The second marked location should be somewhere nearby.
say:0:1120630001:0.source_cn: 手稿上的第二个标记点就在这附近。

say:1:1120630002:0.text: Do we really have to dig up such a huge area?
say:1:1120630002:0.source_cn: 这么大的范围，都要挖吗？

say:2:1120630003:0.text: We could try taking a look around first.
say:2:1120630003:0.source_cn: 我们可以先在四周试试看。

say:0:1120631001:0.text: *Sigh*... There's nothing down here at all!
say:0:1120631001:0.source_cn: 唉，这下面什么都没有啊！

say:1:1120631002:0.text: Don't give up just yet! Looking for treasure is never that simple, remember?
say:1:1120631002:0.source_cn: 找宝藏哪会这么容易，不要泄气呀。

say:0:1120632001:0.text: Still nothing... Are you sure this is the right location?
say:0:1120632001:0.source_cn: 还是什么都没有……手稿上指示的地方真是这里吗？

say:1:1120632002:0.text: Trust me, there's no way I could misinterpret my own father's writing.
say:1:1120632002:0.source_cn: 相信我，父亲的字迹和解密方式，我绝不会搞错。

say:0:1120633001:0.text: ... Something's different about these shrubs. They look a bit shorter than the ones we've seen in other places.
say:0:1120633001:0.source_cn: ……这片灌木有些异常，比其他地点的更矮。
say:0:1120633001:0.male: ... Something's different about these shrubs. They look a bit shorter than the ones we've seen in other places.
say:0:1120633001:0.female: ... Something's different about these shrubs. They look a bit shorter than the ones we've seen in other places.

say:1:1120633002:0.text: Their roots don't seem to run very deep either, which means they haven't had much time to grow.
say:1:1120633002:0.source_cn: 它们的根系也比其他灌木丛浅，生长的时间更短。
say:1:1120633002:0.male: Their roots don't seem to run very deep either, which means they haven't had much time to grow.
say:1:1120633002:0.female: Their roots don't seem to run very deep either, which means they haven't had much time to grow.

say:2:1120633003:0.text: Oh, Chippy knows why! It's because someone dug this place up recently! The treasure must be hidden right here!
say:2:1120633003:0.source_cn: 满满知道了！是因为有人挖开过这里！宝藏一定就在这里！
say:2:1120633003:0.male: Oh, Chippy knows why! It's because someone dug this place up recently! The treasure must be hidden right here!
say:2:1120633003:0.female: Oh, Chippy knows why! It's because someone dug this place up recently! The treasure must be hidden right here!

say:0:1120634001:0.text: Look, Oldiler! It's a small chest!
say:0:1120634001:0.source_cn: 哥哥，你看，地下埋着个小箱子！

say:1:1120634002:0.text: Dura above! Let's see what's inside!

say:2:1120635001:1.text: With the treasure finally in hand, the story reaches its greatest and most exciting chapter!
say:2:1120635001:1.source_cn: 终于到了打开宝箱的时刻，全故事的高光点，最激动人心的章节！

choice_prompt:3:1120635001.text: With the treasure finally in hand, the story reaches its greatest and most exciting chapter!
choice_prompt:3:1120635001.source_cn: 终于到了打开宝箱的时刻，全故事的高光点，最激动人心的章节！

say:4:1120635002:1.text: Let me see... A compass, a shovel, some rope, and a pair of gloves...
say:4:1120635002:1.source_cn: 让我看看……指南针、铁锹、手套、绳索……

say:5:1120635003:1.text: These are just a treasure hunter's tools! Isn't there anything else in here?
say:5:1120635003:1.source_cn: 这些只是宝藏猎人的常用工具！还有没有其他的东西？

say:6:1120635004:1.text: There's also a small, leather-bound journal... Wait, this is father's handwriting! Let's see...
say:6:1120635004:1.source_cn: 还有一本小牛皮的笔记……等等，这是父亲的笔迹！让我看看……

say:9:1120635006:1.text: It's an account of his adventures. He went through the exact same things as us... But he wasn't as lucky in the end.
say:9:1120635006:1.source_cn: 他经历了我们经历的一切，只是他……不像我们这么好运。
say:9:1120635006:1.male: It's an account of his adventures. He went through the exact same things as us... But he wasn't as lucky in the end.
say:9:1120635006:1.female: It's an account of his adventures. He went through the exact same things as us... But he wasn't as lucky in the end.

say:10:1120635007:1.text: His manuscript got stolen by bandits, and just as he was looking for a way to escape, he got stung by a scorpion.
say:10:1120635007:1.source_cn: 匪徒盯上了他，抢走了他的寻宝手稿。他想方设法逃脱了，却...
say:10:1120635007:1.male: His manuscript got stolen by bandits, and just as he was looking for a way to escape, he got stung by a scorpion.
say:10:1120635007:1.female: His manuscript got stolen by bandits, and just as he was looking for a way to escape, he got stung by a scorpion.

say:11:1120635008:1.text: He didn't know about the scorpion antivenom. All he could do in this forsaken place was patch up his wound and keep walking.
say:11:1120635008:1.source_cn: 他没有解毒的知识，在这荒无人烟之地，只能简单处理伤口，...
say:11:1120635008:1.male: He didn't know about the scorpion antivenom. All he could do in this forsaken place was patch up his wound and keep walking.
say:11:1120635008:1.female: He didn't know about the scorpion antivenom. All he could do in this forsaken place was patch up his wound and keep walking.

say:12:1120635009:1.text: And this is where he finally fell...
say:12:1120635009:1.male: And this is where he finally fell...
say:12:1120635009:1.female: And this is where he finally fell...

choice_prompt:13:1120635009.text: And this is where he finally fell...
choice_prompt:13:1120635009.male: And this is where he finally fell...
choice_prompt:13:1120635009.female: And this is where he finally fell...

say:14:1120635010:1.text: Thanks. This really was fate after all. Father guided us here so that we could find his "treasure" together.
say:14:1120635010:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，这确实是天意，是父亲的指引，让我们找到了他留下...
say:14:1120635010:1.male: Thanks. This really was fate after all. Father guided us here so that we could find his "treasure" together.
say:14:1120635010:1.female: Thanks. This really was fate after all. Father guided us here so that we could find his "treasure" together.

say:15:1120635011:1.text: It's a shame that we were too late.
say:15:1120635011:1.source_cn: 只可惜，我们来得晚了一些。
say:15:1120635011:1.male: It's a shame that we were too late.
say:15:1120635011:1.female: It's a shame that we were too late.

say:16:1120635012:1.text: "... I can feel my life ebbing away. The world is still so full of treasure waiting to be discovered, but unfortunately, my time is at its end."
say:16:1120635012:1.source_cn: “……我能感觉到生命在流逝，我相信还有尚未被发现的宝藏...

say:17:1120635013:1.text: "To my sons, Oldiler and Evan, please forgive me. I know I was never a good father. I failed to make a better life for you or even stay at your side..."
say:17:1120635013:1.source_cn: “对不起，我亲爱的欧迪尔和艾文，我不是个好父亲。没能给...

say:18:1120635014:1.text: "But if you treat life as one long treasure hunt, then the sights you see along the way... the singing birds in the trees, the sunset over the desert, the storms in distant seas... Perhaps those are the greatest treasures to discover."
say:18:1120635014:1.source_cn: “但……如果将生命看作一次寻宝，那些沿途的风景……丛林...

say:19:1120635015:1.text: "Nevertheless, I pray that you two will walk a different path. The way of the treasure hunter is fraught with danger and hardship. Even the worst father would not wish this life for his children."
say:19:1120635015:1.source_cn: “不过，我仍然希望欧迪尔和艾文不要走上这条路。这条路太...

say:20:1120635016:1.text: "With these last moments, I beseech the gods... Dura, the Dusk Lord, or whichever deity that watches over us..."
say:20:1120635016:1.source_cn: “最后……艾雅女神也好，残阳神也好，无论什么神灵都好……”

say:21:1120635017:1.source_cn: “请保佑艾文和欧迪尔能收到……”

say:0:1120636001:0.text: Father... What should we do now, Oldiler?
say:0:1120636001:0.source_cn: 父亲……哥哥，我们现在该怎么办？

say:1:1120636002:0.text: Wait, there's a letter tucked into the notebook...
say:1:1120636002:0.source_cn: 等等，笔记里还夹着一封信……

say:3:1120637001:1.text: I never thought we would find our father like this after all these years.
say:3:1120637001:1.source_cn: 没想到，我们会以这种方式和父亲重逢。

say:4:1120637002:1.text: He was always traveling the world in search of treasure, and he rarely came home... When he did, he would promise to find enough treasure to give us the best life possible.
say:4:1120637002:1.source_cn: 以前他总是满世界寻宝，很少回家……他总说要找到无人发现...

say:5:1120637003:1.text: The truth is, Oldiler... as much as I wanted to see him again, I was also afraid to know what happened to him.
say:5:1120637003:1.source_cn: 你知道吗，哥哥……一直以来，我既希望能找到他，又害怕知...

say:6:1120637004:1.text: I was scared to find out that he really abandoned us or worse... that he had died somewhere far away.
say:6:1120637004:1.source_cn: 因为我怕他真的抛弃了我们，更怕他……死在外乡。

say:7:1120637005:1.text: I know how you feel, Evan... But we found him all the same.
say:7:1120637005:1.source_cn: 我明白你的感受……但，我们找到他了。

say:8:1120637006:1.text: Come on, let's find some stuff to make a proper grave for him.
say:8:1120637006:1.source_cn: 来吧，我们找些材料，立好墓碑。

say:9:1120637007:1.text: Compared to our hometown, I'm sure he liked this place a lot more. After all, it's where you can see Esperia's most beautiful sunsets.
say:9:1120637007:1.source_cn: 相比于家乡，我觉得父亲更喜欢这里——这里有伊索米亚最壮...

say:10:1120637008:1.text: And he said this was one of the greatest treasures to be discovered.
say:10:1120637008:1.source_cn: 他说了，这是他人生旅途上的宝藏。

say:0:1120638001:0.text: Chippy knows we're supposed to offer fresh flowers at a grave, but where do you find flowers in a desert?
say:0:1120638001:0.source_cn: 按照常理，该在墓前献上鲜花的，可这样的砂地，不会有鲜花……

say:1:1120638002:0.text: Maybe a desert plant will do? Like a blazing orchid!
say:1:1120638002:0.source_cn: 或许，当地的植物也可以吧，比如炽焰兰。

say:2:1120638003:0.text: A flower as beautiful as the desert sunset... I'm sure your father would like that.
say:2:1120638003:0.source_cn: 和落日一样美丽的炽焰兰，他们的父亲也会喜欢的吧……

say:1:1120639001:0.text: His tombstone is finished now... Rest in peace, Father.
say:1:1120639001:0.source_cn: 墓碑上的名字已经刻好。宁静地睡吧，父亲。

say:3:1120639002:0.text: Being laid to rest in the desert under the setting sun... Is this what father wanted?
say:3:1120639002:0.source_cn: 枕着夕阳，横卧砂地六尺之下，这些就是父亲想要的吗？

say:4:1120639003:0.text: He was right about the life of a treasure hunter being full of danger...
say:4:1120639003:0.source_cn: 他说得没错，宝藏猎人这个职业确实十分危险……
say:4:1120639003:0.male: He was right about the life of a treasure hunter being full of danger...
say:4:1120639003:0.female: He was right about the life of a treasure hunter being full of danger...

choice_prompt:5:1120639003.text: He was right about the life of a treasure hunter being full of danger...
choice_prompt:5:1120639003.source_cn: 他说得没错，宝藏猎人这个职业确实十分危险……
choice_prompt:5:1120639003.male: He was right about the life of a treasure hunter being full of danger...
choice_prompt:5:1120639003.female: He was right about the life of a treasure hunter being full of danger...

say:6:1120639004:1.text: I've given it a lot of thought, and I'm done shouting about being a treasure hunter.
say:6:1120639004:1.source_cn: 我……我不会再喊着要当宝藏猎人了。这是我深刻思考后的决定。
say:6:1120639004:1.male: I've given it a lot of thought, and I'm done shouting about being a treasure hunter.
say:6:1120639004:1.female: I've given it a lot of thought, and I'm done shouting about being a treasure hunter.
